title: polypodium elongatum
intro: Polypodium elongatum, commonly known as American polypody, is a species of fern native to eastern North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Polypodium elongatum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents in Polypodium elongatum contribute to its potential therapeutic applications, including the treatment of wounds, infections, and other conditions.
